commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Guillermo Cuadra has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' The referee makes a quick call and awards Domingos Duarte (Getafe) a red card.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The game has come to an end for Thierry Correia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sergi Canos (Valencia).
90' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) replacing Yarek Gasiorowski.
88' Javi Guerra (Valencia) is sent off by the referee after receiving a harsh red card!

87' 1 - 0 Goal! Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Borja Mayoral (Getafe), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 1:0.
84' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
84' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
83' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Jordi is replaced by Stefan Mitrovic (Getafe).
83' The ball goes behind for a corner. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) will replace Diego Lopez.
80' Jaime Mata (Getafe) connects with a cross and shoots to the left side of the goal, but he can't get the power to direct it past Giorgi Mamardashvili, who makes a good save.
78' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Jaime Mata (Getafe) is replacing Juanmi Latasa.
74' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
73' A cross from Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
71' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Djene and he is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
70' The manager makes a subsitution with Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) coming on for Luis Milla.
69' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
67' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes.

64' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Getafe will take a throw-in.
62' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Djene (Getafe) for his blatant foul.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Getafe.

59' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
57' Luis Milla (Getafe) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
57' Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.

57' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The ball is out of play. Getafe will have a chance to score from a corner.
54' Ruben Baraja makes a tactical change due to a red card. Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) comes on in place of Fran Perez.
54' Ruben Baraja is stunned as referee Guillermo Cuadra shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
53' Getafe seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
52' The ball is cleared after Fran Perez (Valencia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
49' The attendance for today's match is 11515.
48' Javi Guerra (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' A tremendous drive by Borja Mayoral (Getafe) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a brilliant save.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
43' Gabriel Paulista (Valencia) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
42' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thierry Correia (Valencia) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jordi (Getafe) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' Great teamplay by Getafe as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

37' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity! The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
35' Diego Lopez (Valencia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
28' A pass by Thierry Correia (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. It's a throw-in for Getafe.
26' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
22' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia).
16' Jordi (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Fran Perez (Valencia) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
12' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
9' Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
5' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Thierry Correia (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
